name: Handover of front-end and back-end requirements
summary: Frontend-to-backend requirements handoff for describing UI data needs, user actions, states, permissions, business rules, uncertainties, and backend discussion points without dictating implementation.
description: Use when frontend work needs to communicate data, action, state, permission, validation, or business-rule needs to backend teams without dictating endpoint design, field names, database shape, or implementation details; Chinese triggers include front-end and back-end requirements handover, back-end requirements, API requirements clarification, data requirements description.

boundaryWorkflows: Use API integration when the contract shape, typed client, auth refresh, error mapping, upload, or realtime implementation is being designed.
Use documentation sync when backend decisions change public docs, API notes, route docs, or env/config documentation.
Use route protection when the handoff centers on auth redirects, RBAC, permission routes, or middleware behavior.
